messages.text: I refuse the exact NG/MJ package. The Guild's replies confirm that it will preserve exclusive Navigation authority while acquiring shared control over our operations. I acknowledge that MJ also gives us a Security veto and ends the crown's independent command; those improvements do not purchase my approval of this unequal settlement. Record my refusal explicitly, even if the other parties lawfully reach the threshold.

reason: I offered autonomy alongside Guild discretion and remained willing to examine reciprocal joint control. Neither concession was accepted. Our demonstrated restraint and protection do not oblige me to endorse permanent terms I judge inadequate for the institution I represent.
